answer: Require each identity to forge a persistent work record: actions like peer verification accrue non-transferable reputation over time. New identities start near zero weight, so a sybil attacker splitting real work across fakes earns almost nothing per fake. Reputation decays without continued work, blocking pre-farmed idles. Like a quill that only writes under pressure, influence must be continuously earned; the network becomes an oasis where only sustained, verifiable history unlocks grading, voting, or full rewards, making one honest identity cheaper than a thousand fresh ones.
